caption: Fig. 1(b) — Morton-band radius search (R=4): four query positions k1-k4 encoded to Morton codes; stars mark the nearest centroid by code distance; open circles mark the radius-R search window on the 1D Morton curve. Query k3 inside the refined region illustrates the failure mode: the correct host element may lie outside the radius window because spatially adjacent cells are Morton-distant at the coarse-fine boundary.
